articles.summary: Three in four small and midsize business employers now use AI at least weekly, and it is changing what people do faster than it is changing headcount. This article covers how AI is used at work today, what TriNet’s 2027 State of the Workplace report shows about changing roles and workloads, and the steps employers can take to redesign jobs with intent. Readers come away with a practical plan for task mapping, job descriptions, reskilling, AI guidance, and honest conversations about job security.
articles.title: AI in the Workplace: How Jobs Are Changing and How to Redesign Roles

articles.summary: TriNet, a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small and medium-size businesses (SMBs) today unveiled its 2027 State of the Workplace report, an annual look at employer and employee sentiment across the SMB landscape throughout the nation.
articles.title: TriNet Unveils 2027 State of the Workplace Report

articles.summary: Learn why leaders and employees may experience company culture differently and how to close the culture perception gap through listening and alignment.
articles.title: When Leaders and Employees See Culture Differently: How to close the culture perception gap

articles.summary: A PEO gives a small business access to big-company benefits, HR expertise, and compliance support through a co-employment model. This guide explains how a PEO works, what it costs, what it does and doesn't support, and how to choose one. You'll leave able to judge whether a PEO fits your business.
articles.title: PEO for Small Business: Benefits, Costs, and How to Choose One

articles.summary: Small and midsize businesses can build an employee experience strategy their people recognize by measuring how employees see the workplace alongside how leaders see it. Drawing on TriNet’s 2027 State of the Workplace report, this article explores where employer and employee may view differ most, how the difference may show up in why people leave, and seven steps to help close it. You’ll leave with practical considerations, from a short two-sided survey to communicating to your employees what the company already offers.
articles.title: Employee Experience Strategy: 7 Steps to Close the Employer-Employee Gap

articles.summary: Clear employee benefits communication helps employees understand, choose, and use the benefits a company already pays for. TriNet’s 2027 State of the Workplace report found that 80% of employers believe employees understand their benefits while 65% of employees say they do, and this article shows where that gap appears and the steps that help close it. You’ll come away with a year-round communication plan and a short survey for checking what employees understand.
articles.title: Employee Benefits Communication: How to Close the Understanding Gap

articles.summary: Stay on top of key HR compliance tasks and deadlines with this practical checklist covering hiring, payroll, benefits, reporting and more.
articles.title: HR Compliance Checklist: Key Requirements for Employers | TriNet

articles.summary: Despite the passage of the Equal Pay Act of 1963, disparities in earnings persist across industries and job levels. With wage gap impacts also following women into retirement, learn more about how SMBs can support their entire workforce.
articles.title: Pay Equity Matters: Continuing the Conversation on Wage Disparities for SMBs
